title: ValdoEngine
description: ValdoEngine is the official ValdoReams mod adding new ores, armor, tools and content exclusive to the server.
body:
## ⚙️ ValdoEngine – The Official ValdoReams Server Mod
**ValdoEngine is the main mod used by the ValdoReams server**. It adds new ores, unique armor, tools, blocks, and various exclusive content designed specifically to enrich the gameplay experience.

### ✨ Added Content
- New ores unique to the server
- Custom armor and tools
- Special items and exclusive mechanics
- Additional blocks and resources for gameplay

### 🎯 Role of the Mod
ValdoEngine serves as the technical and content foundation for the ValdoReams server. It centralizes all the project's new features and guarantees a consistent, balanced, and 100% personalized experience.
